reason: ₹4,999 upfront and then ₹999 every single month, forever, just to do what my register and WhatsApp already do for free. That's twelve thousand a year out of my pocket, and I don't take monthly subscriptions.
objection: Who will help me when the app stops working on a busy Sunday with customers waiting? And it's all in English, so my girls will keep calling me instead of using it.
would_change_my_mind: A one-time price with no monthly fee, and a Hindi version with a local person I can phone on Sundays.
